summary: On July 2, 2026 a social engineering attack deceived a Cook Medical employee into inadvertently giving an outside party access to some company systems. The attacker accessed contact information for U.S. and Canadian customers, records of customer communications in Salesforce, employee names and email addresses, and some internal business files from SharePoint. Cook contained the access the same day and found no evidence that sensitive or protected health information was accessed.
